definitions.gloss: out of battery; dead battery; battery depleted
definitions.explanation: The state where a device's battery has run out of charge and the device no longer functions.

examples.japanese: スマホが{充電|じゅうでん}{切|き}れになった。
examples.english: My smartphone ran out of battery.

examples.japanese: {充電|じゅうでん}{切|き}れで{連絡|れんらく}できなかった。
examples.english: I couldn't contact you because my phone was dead.

examples.japanese: {外出先|がいしゅつさき}での{充電|じゅうでん}{切|き}れが{心配|しんぱい}だから、モバイルバッテリーを{持|も}ち{歩|ある}いている。
examples.english: I carry a portable charger because I worry about running out of battery when I'm out.

notes:
{充電|じゅうでん}{切|き}れ describes a common modern-day problem.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {充電|じゅうでん}が{切|き}れる (battery dies)
- {充電|じゅうでん}が{切|き}れそう (battery is about to die)
- バッテリー{切|ぎ}れ (battery dead, alternate expression)

PREVENTION:
- モバイルバッテリー: portable charger
- {充電|じゅうでん}スポット: charging station
- {省電力|しょうでんりょく}モード: power-saving mode

RELATED TERMS:
- {充電|じゅうでん}: charging
- {残量|ざんりょう}: remaining charge
